The enableSqlExpressions security check only guards the ReadQuery code path used when FlagExpressionParser is enabled, but in default configuration buildCMDNode calls UnmarshalSQLCommand directly for TypeSQL, completely bypassing this check - the security gate should be added to the TypeSQL case in buildCMDNode or within UnmarshalSQLCommand

The enableSqlExpressions function always returns false in both branches, making the feature flag check and negation dead code - the function body should be simplified to just return false to avoid confusing future maintainers who might misinterpret the inverted flag logic
